description: Expected results for the official tRIBS Happy Jack benchmark (Zenodo 10909507, SNOTEL point-scale run at Happy Jack, AZ; start 06/01/2002, RUNTIME 143183 h ~ 16.3 years, hourly forcing). Pass needs BOTH (a) all 9 official black-box tests of the tRIBS repo (testing/black_box/happy_jack_pytest/test_happy_jack.py) to pass with their own thresholds (forcing in = forcing recorded; water balance |P - losses - dS| < 10 mm/yr; KGE of daily SWE vs SNOTEL > 1 - sqrt(2)), and (b) the numbers below.

numeric_checks.name: part9_reached
numeric_checks.why: model's own end line 'Part 9: Deleting Objects and Exiting Program' (KI tool finding)

numeric_checks.name: official_tests_passed
numeric_checks.why: all 9 official black-box tests pass (official method and thresholds)

numeric_checks.name: official_water_balance_metric_mm_per_yr
numeric_checks.why: value printed by the official water-balance test; the official limit is |x| < 10 mm/yr

numeric_checks.name: official_kge_swe_vs_snotel
numeric_checks.why: value printed by the official KGE test (daily SWE vs SNOTEL); the official limit is > -0.4142

numeric_checks.name: precip_total_minus_official_reference_mm
numeric_checks.why: total rain in the run equals the total in the official reference output (results/reference.zip, hj_ref0.pixel): same forcing goes in

numeric_checks.name: n_pixel_records
numeric_checks.why: one hourly pixel record per hour of RUNTIME

numeric_checks.name: precip_total_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of Rain_mm_h over the run

numeric_checks.name: et_total_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of EvpTtrs_mm_h (own run; repeat run bit-identical)

numeric_checks.name: surface_runoff_total_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of Srf_Hour_mm (surface runoff per output hour; the column the official water-balance test sums) (own run; repeat bit-identical)

numeric_checks.name: swe_max_cm
numeric_checks.why: peak snow water equivalent SnWE_cm (own run)

numeric_checks.name: nwt_end_mm
numeric_checks.why: final water table depth Nwt_mm (own run)

numeric_checks.name: mu_end_mm
numeric_checks.why: final unsaturated zone moisture Mu_mm (own run)

recorded_with: /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/tRIBS/source/repo/build/tRIBS run through the KI tool tools/run_tribs.py on the unchanged official inputs (pack tRIBS/happy_jack_v1); python_env pytRIBS for the official tests
reference: Official parts: the 9 pass/fail tests and their thresholds come from the tRIBS repo black-box suite (copied unchanged into inputs/happy_jack_pytest/). The official results/reference.zip is used for the precip-total check. The other numbers are from our own runs: two clean runs gave bit-identical output files.
notes: The official reference.zip was made in March 2024 with an older tRIBS. The current tRIBS 5.3.0 adds an output column (ShortRadInSlope_W_m2) and gives somewhat different states (e.g. peak SWE 61.75 cm vs 54.92 cm in the reference; SWE correlation run vs reference ~0.96; ET 3359 vs 3406 mm). So the reference outputs are NOT a bit-for-bit target, and the official black-box tests do not use them either. run_reference.py prints this comparison as information only.
